events.name: Bash
events.head: Show task tool help and find Zoom lock code
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py --help 2>&1 | head -40; grep -rIl "zoom_support_locks\|zoom_s2s_enc" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls ~/.config/tantra/ 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read existing Zoom support check script and related admin routes
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs; git log --oneline -5 -- workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs; git status --short workshop-plan/ops | head; grep -n "zoom_support_locks\|support_locks\|checkInZoom\|zoom/check\|reapply\|re-apply" cloud/src/*.ts cloud/admin-ui/admin.js | head -50

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the daily Zoom check job is installed and the task's full log
events.input: $ ls workshop-plan/ops/ | grep -i zoom; launchctl list | grep -i zoom; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -i zoom; git show --stat 756ff0c | head -20; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the read-only Zoom grant check and inspect the daily job
events.input: $ node workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -45; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.zoom-support-check 2>/dev/null | grep -E "state|last exit|Hour|Minute|runs"

events.text:
T-225 stays blocked on Zoom Support only: today's read-only check shows no grant yet, the daily 09:10 check is loaded and will log, apply and confirm the grant itself, and nothing is asked of Adi.

Two limits on that check:
- **Account settings not readable:** the Zoom app lacks the account-settings read scope, so that call returns 400 and only the user settings and the two meetings (87002851906 and 88135386601) are actually read.
- **A grant may not show on a read:** the fields might only appear once written, and I did not run a test write because only read-only calls were approved.

The ack for F-08ee4eb4 returned "acked 0", so it appears to have been acknowledged already by the earlier run today.
